ctl.carries: Encrypted authenticated commands; host admission still applies.

ctlr.carries: Encrypted command responses for exactly the named viewer and request-scoped reply key.

ho.carries: Opaque handoff packages and handoff receipts; existing account-wide routing remains unchanged.

t.carries: Transcript chunks requested by a viewer.

command_effect.does_not_prove: Downstream task completion, durable acceptance beyond that result, or human observation.
command_effect.proves: Authenticated encrypted command-specific result for the correlated request.

human_observation.does_not_prove: Observation by GET, prefetch, background refresh, push acceptance or another viewer.
human_observation.proves: Explicit per-viewer durable observation mutation for this receipt version.

machine_durable_acceptance.does_not_prove: Schedule dispatch, execution outcome or human observation.
machine_durable_acceptance.proves: The named machine durably accepted this delivery.

pairing_finalization.does_not_prove: An authenticated issuer by digest alone, arbitrary command execution or human observation.
pairing_finalization.proves: The named pairing finalization body and its byte digest.

relay_fanout.does_not_prove: Machine durable acceptance, command effect, viewer decryption or human observation.
relay_fanout.proves: Relay attempted fanout via socket send.

webhook_ingress.does_not_prove: Machine receipt, dispatch, task execution or human observation.
webhook_ingress.proves: Cloud accepted and durably recorded this webhook delivery.
